text: In twenty twelve, a trading firm lost four hundred and forty million dollars in forty-five minutes. Knight Capital copied new trading code onto eight servers. The technician missed one. The new code reused an old on-off switch. On the eighth server, that switch woke up Power Peg, a test program nobody had used for years. It bought high and sold low, over and over, millions of orders. By the time they pulled the plug, Knight was losing about ten million dollars a minute. Dave was in charge of copying the files.
